terms.gloss: a wave, a billow, above all of the sea
evidence: Cic. Fam. 9.16.6: flūctum ā saxō frangī (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Fin. 5.5: ad flūctum ajunt dēclāmāre solitum Dēmosthenem (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From fluō; most often in the plural.

phrases.english: Do you want big waves or little waves?

phrases.latin: ad flūctum ajunt dēclāmāre solitum Dēmosthenem, ut fremitum assuēsceret vōce vincere
phrases.english: they say Demosthenes used to declaim to the waves, to accustom himself to mastering a roar with his voice

sources: The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
